inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Detect creation of a User-Delegation Key

properties.description: This detection identifies when a User Delegation Key is created in an Azure Storage account. A user delegation key allows a user or service principal, authenticated through Azure AD, to generate Shared Access Signatures (SAS) with fine-grained access control. The operation GetUserDelegationKey is used to request such keys via the Azure Storage REST API
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Detect creation of a User-Delegation Key
properties.query:
// Replace with your table name where storage blob logs are stored
StorageBlobLogs
| where OperationName == "GetUserDelegationKey" // the REST API that issues a delegation key
| project TimeGenerated,
          StorageAccount = _ResourceId,
          Caller = AccountName,   // or Identity, if available
          AuthenticationType,
          ObjectKey,
          StatusCode = toint(StatusCode),
          RequestUri = tostring(Uri),
          CorrelationId = tostring(CorrelationId),
          SignedTid = tostring(TenantId),
          CallerIpAddress
| where StatusCode == 200
